integrity: Explicit proof and standalone independent-algorithm finite checks are provided; the scientific claims have had a same-model review but no independent mathematical validation or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The rigidity equivalence uses normality of every point stabilizer, guaranteed for Dedekind groups, and fails in general for S_3. Named group action and named exhaustive disjoint colours are essential. Formal products count rigid isomorphism types, not arbitrary maps. Historical priority is provisional; earlier categorical/cofree or generalized necklace literature may subsume a formulation. Finite computations do not replace the all-parameter proof.
title: Rigid coloured actions of finite Dedekind groups as full-shift substructures
